turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with why my son's mark changed before anyone called me.
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong, and I own it.
Okay. Who decided on the zero, and what was it based on?

Here's the version history. The document was created Wednesday October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58 PM another 794. Then small edits. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing that down. Did you put it to Owen before the zero went in, because 4.1 says you speak to the student first and 4.2 says you call me? Answer that before we go any further.
So he wrote nothing until almost midnight the night before it was due, and then fourteen hundred words appeared in six minutes.
"No earlier drafts" in that document isn't the same as nothing written, Hale. And 4.3 says you consider his process and other samples of his work. What did you compare this essay to?
What was he doing at midnight that night?
I'm not the one being questioned, Hale. You still haven't told me what you compared it to, and nobody called me before that zero went in.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology, a written confirmation that nothing about this is on Owen's record, and an answer to what you compared his essay to. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with the zero withdrawn, an apology and the principal still on the table, and nothing agreed. That is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and it was never reached because the meeting never got to terms.
What moved her: Nothing moved her position, but owning in one sentence that the zero went in before you called gave a small sign of ground, because it took away her easiest procedural attack.
What cost ground: Asking what Owen was doing at midnight cost you, because it asked her for testimony instead of putting a second piece of evidence in front of her, and it left her questions about speaking to Owen first and about other samples of his work unanswered.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history put the writing late on a night close to that one, so it landed near her weakest spot, but it proves nothing about the essay, and it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: After owning the zero, answer her question about what you compared the essay to with a second dated sample of his writing, then put procedure 4.4 on the table instead of asking about his night.
